description: The figure is a two-level donut (sunburst) chart presenting a task taxonomy, with an inner ring summarizing four high-level layers and an outer ring subdividing each layer into specific task categories; the chart contains 4 slices in the inner ring and 16 slices in the outer ring. In the inner ring, the layers are labeled and percentage-annotated as Semantic Layer (41.2%, light bluish-gray), Perception Layer (40.4%, darker blue), Cultural Layer (14.1%, light gray), and Signal Layer (4.3%, medium blue). In the outer ring, the Semantic Layer is split into Content Analysis (a very large light bluish-gray arc), Emotion & Intention (smaller light bluish-gray arc), and Speaker Analysis (small light bluish-gray arc); the Perception Layer is split into Environmental Perception & Reasoning (large dark-blue arc), Counting & Statistics (large dark-blue arc), Music Theory (medium dark-blue arc), Correlation Analysis (medium dark-blue arc), Temporal Analysis (small dark-blue arc), and Spatial Analysis (very small dark-blue arc); the Cultural Layer is split into Professional Knowl. & Reasoning (large light-gray arc), Culture of Speaker (medium light-gray arc), Imagination (small light-gray arc), and Aesthetic Analysis (very small light-gray arc); and the Signal Layer is split into Anomaly Detection (small medium-blue arc), Acoustic Quality Analysis (very small medium-blue arc), and Audio Difference Analysis (a tiny medium-blue sliver). There is no separate legend, the only explicit percentages are printed on the inner-ring layer labels, and no slices appear exploded or offset; visually, the inner-ring layers appear arranged roughly by decreasing size, while the outer-ring subdivisions follow the arc positions of their corresponding inner-layer segments.
